claims.statement: Tom Allen and Benjamin Hogan signed articles of agreement for a fight, dated September 25, 1873; Arthur Chambers witnessed for Allen.
claims.excerpt: Articles of agreeMent entered into this 35th day

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Benjamin Hogan agreed to a fair stand-up fight under the new rules for $1,000 a side, on Tuesday, October 28, 1873, with the ground to be picked by one man from each side.

claims.statement: Allen declined Hogan's request to postpone the fight by two weeks, and Hogan did not object.

claims.statement: Tom Allen's second knuckle on his right hand was slightly cut in the Tuesday fight (printed as 'band').

claims.statement: Tom Allen said he planned to enjoy himself for two weeks and then return to training.
